card.name: Lowest dose, shortest duration wording
card.fires_on: The superlative word (shortest, lowest, smallest) in standard label advice to use the least dose, duration or quantity. It is strongest on "shortest" after "lowest effective dose for the".

modes.label: Shortest duration
modes.description: "shortest" after "lowest effective dose/dosage for the" in NSAID warnings.
modes.example: Use the lowest effective dosage for the<< shortest>> possible duration.

modes.label: Lowest or smallest amount
modes.description: "lowest" or "smallest" in phrases about the least effective dose or quantity.
modes.example: Strategies to reduce these risks include prescribing the drug in the<< smallest>> appropriate quantity

card.writes: It pushes the model toward minimum-type words such as minimum, lowest and range, in several languages.
card.plain: It marks the word "shortest" or "smallest" in the standard advice to use the least amount for the least time.
